svg.aria-label: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning by parameter share: the 46 expert stacks hold 93 percent of the parameters, and in the shelf's smallest build every one is silently rewritten to IQ4_NL at 4.5 bits per weight. The IQ2_XXS label names 12 of the build's 417 tensors, and not one expert stack is among them. The file lands at 17.54 GiB.
svg.text: What the shelf's “IQ2_XXS” label actually names
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, by parameter share — what the build's quantizer did to each part
silently rewritten to IQ4_NL at 4.5 bits/weight — 256 does not divide these rows
the label names 12 of the build's 417 tensors — not one expert stack is among them
Result: a 2-bit-class label on a 17.54 GiB file.
A 16 GiB card is over before the first runtime buffer allocates. The fallback is the quantizer's, not the publisher's.
Every number from the published model card; the label share is 12 of 417 tensors, the stacks hold 93% of parameters.
